lines.text: Jezebel threatens Elijah, so he runs for his life and leaves his servant in Beersheba.
Under a broom tree Elijah prays to die, then an angel feeds him and he walks forty days to Sinai.
A great wind, an earthquake and a fire pass by, but the LORD is in none of them.
The LORD tells Elijah to anoint Hazael king over Aram, Jehu king over Israel, and Elisha as prophet.
Elijah throws his belt around Elisha, who then slaughters his oxen and follows him.
